mapper.select: select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, case s.gender when '0' then '男' when '1' then '女' else '' end as gender, date_format(s.birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, s.enrollment_year as enrollmentYear, s.education_level as educationLevel, case s.student_status when '0' then '在读' when '1' then '休学' when '2' then '退学' when '3' then '毕业' when '4' then '转出' when '5' then '保留学籍' else '' end as studentStatusText, ifnull(m.major_name, '') as majorName, ifnull(c.class_name, '') as className, ifnull(d.dept_name, '') as deptName from sam_student s left join brm_major m on m.major_id = s.major_id left join brm_class c on c.class_id = s.class_id left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id where s.student_id = #{studentId}

select ifnull(cl.course_code, '') as courseCode, ifnull(cl.course_name, concat('课程', g.course_id)) as courseName, ifnull(cl.credit, 0) as credit, ifnull(cl.total_hours, 0) as totalHours, case cl.course_type when '0' then '必修' when '1' then '选修' else ifnull(cl.course_type, '') end as courseType, sem.semester_name as semesterName, case g.exam_type when '0' then '正考' when '1' then '补考' when '2' then '重修' else '' end as examTypeText, ifnull(g.regular_score, 0) as regularScore, ifnull(g.exam_score, 0) as examScore, ifnull(g.total_score, 0) as totalScore, ifnull(g.grade_point, 0) as gradePoint, ifnull(g.grade_level, '') as gradeLevel, case g.is_pass when '1' then '是' else '否' end as isPassText from aem_grade_record g left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = g.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = g.semester_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0' and g.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by g.semester_id, cl.course_code
select semester_name from brm_semester where semester_id = #{semesterId}

select distinct sem.semester_name from aem_grade_record g join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = g.semester_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0' and g.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by sem.semester_id
select distinct g.student_id from aem_grade_record g join sam_student s on s.student_id = g.student_id and s.status = '0' where g.status = '0' and g.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by g.student_id

select ct.cert_id as certId, ct.cert_number as certNumber, date_format(ct.cert_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as certDate, case ct.cert_type when '0' then '毕业证书' when '1' then '学位证书' when '2' then '结业证书' else '证书' end as certTypeName, ifnull(ct.education_level, ifnull(s.education_level, '')) as educationLevel, ifnull(m.major_name, '') as majorName, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, case s.gender when '0' then '男' when '1' then '女' else '' end as gender, date_format(s.birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, s.enrollment_year as enrollmentYear from sam_certificate ct join sam_student s on s.student_id = ct.student_id left join brm_major m on m.major_id = ct.major_id where ct.cert_id = #{certId}

select st.seat_id as seatId, st.seat_number as seatNumber, st.row_number as rowNumber, st.col_number as colNumber, e.exam_name as examName, ifnull(cl.course_name, '') as courseName, ifnull(cl.course_code, '') as courseCode, date_format(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as examDate, e.start_time as startTime, e.end_time as endTime, ifnull(e.duration, 0) as duration, sem.semester_name as semesterName, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, ifnull(cr.capacity, 0) as capacity, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, ifnull(m.major_name, '') as majorName, ifnull(c.class_name, '') as className from aem_exam_seat st join aem_exam_plan e on e.exam_id = st.exam_id left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = e.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = e.semester_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = st.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id join sam_student s on s.student_id = st.student_id left join brm_major m on m.major_id = s.major_id left join brm_class c on c.class_id = s.class_id where st.seat_id = #{seatId}
select seat_id from aem_exam_seat where exam_id = #{examId} and student_id is not null and status = '0' order by seat_id

select ifnull(cl.course_name, concat('课程', off.course_id)) as courseName, ifnull(cl.course_code, '') as courseCode, ifnull(t.teacher_name, '') as teacherName, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, sc.week_day as weekDay, sc.start_period as startPeriod, sc.end_period as endPeriod, sc.start_week as startWeek, sc.end_week as endWeek, ifnull(cl.credit, 0) as credit, sem.semester_name as semesterName from tpm_selection_enrollment e join tpm_course_offering off on off.offering_id = e.course_offering_id and off.del_flag = '0' join tpm_schedule sc on sc.offering_id = off.offering_id and sc.del_flag = '0' and sc.status = '0' left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = off.course_id left join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = off.teacher_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = sc.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = off.semester_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.del_flag = '0' and e.result_status = '1' and off.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by sc.week_day, sc.start_period, cl.course_code

select ifnull(cl.course_name, concat('课程', off.course_id)) as courseName, ifnull(cl.course_code, '') as courseCode, ifnull(t.teacher_name, '') as teacherName, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, sc.week_day as weekDay, sc.start_period as startPeriod, sc.end_period as endPeriod, sc.start_week as startWeek, sc.end_week as endWeek, ifnull(cl.credit, 0) as credit, sem.semester_name as semesterName from tpm_course_offering off join tpm_schedule sc on sc.offering_id = off.offering_id and sc.del_flag = '0' and sc.status = '0' left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = off.course_id left join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = off.teacher_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = sc.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = off.semester_id where off.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and off.del_flag = '0' and off.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by sc.week_day, sc.start_period, cl.course_code

select iv.invigilation_id as invigilationId, case iv.duty_type when '0' then '主监考' when '1' then '副监考' when '2' then '巡考' else '监考' end as dutyTypeName, e.exam_name as examName, ifnull(cl.course_name, '') as courseName, date_format(ifnull(iv.exam_date, e.exam_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as examDate, ifnull(iv.start_time, e.start_time) as startTime, ifnull(iv.end_time, e.end_time) as endTime, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, ifnull(cr.capacity, 0) as capacity, t.teacher_name as teacherName, t.teacher_code as teacherCode, ifnull(d.dept_name, '') as deptName, sem.semester_name as semesterName, (select group_concat(distinct concat(t2.teacher_name, '（', case iv2.duty_type when '0' then '主' when '1' then '副' else '巡' end, '）') order by iv2.invigilation_id separator '、') from aem_exam_invigilation iv2 join brm_teacher t2 on t2.teacher_id = iv2.teacher_id where iv2.exam_id = iv.exam_id and iv2.classroom_id = iv.classroom_id and iv2.status = '0' and iv2.teacher_id is not null) as partners from aem_exam_invigilation iv join aem_exam_plan e on e.exam_id = iv.exam_id left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = e.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = e.semester_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = iv.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = iv.teacher_id left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = t.dept_id where iv.invigilation_id = #{invigilationId}
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{studentId} and del_flag = '0'
select ct.student_id from sam_certificate ct join sys_user u on u.user_id = ct.student_id and u.del_flag = '0' where ct.cert_id = #{certId}
select student_id from sam_student where student_id = #{userId} limit 1
select u.user_id from aem_exam_seat st join sys_user u on u.user_id = st.student_id and u.del_flag = '0' where st.seat_id = #{seatId}

select u.user_id from aem_exam_invigilation iv join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = iv.teacher_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = ifnull(t.user_id, t.teacher_id) and u.del_flag = '0' where iv.invigilation_id = #{invigilationId}

select st.seat_id as seatId, e.exam_name as examName, ifnull(cl.course_name, '') as courseName, ifnull(cl.course_code, '') as courseCode, date_format(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as examDate, e.start_time as startTime, e.end_time as endTime, sem.semester_name as semesterName, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, st.seat_number as seatNumber from aem_exam_seat st join aem_exam_plan e on e.exam_id = st.exam_id left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = e.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = e.semester_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = st.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id where st.student_id = #{userId} and st.status = '0' order by e.exam_date, st.seat_id

select iv.invigilation_id as invigilationId, e.exam_name as examName, ifnull(cl.course_name, '') as courseName, date_format(ifnull(iv.exam_date, e.exam_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as examDate, ifnull(iv.start_time, e.start_time) as startTime, ifnull(iv.end_time, e.end_time) as endTime, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), ifnull(cr.classroom_name, '')) as classroomName, case iv.duty_type when '0' then '主监考' when '1' then '副监考' when '2' then '巡考' else '监考' end as dutyTypeName, sem.semester_name as semesterName from aem_exam_invigilation iv join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = iv.teacher_id join aem_exam_plan e on e.exam_id = iv.exam_id left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = e.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = e.semester_id left join brm_classroom cr on cr.classroom_id = iv.classroom_id left join brm_building b on b.building_id = cr.building_id where ifnull(t.user_id, t.teacher_id) = #{userId} and iv.status = '0' order by ifnull(iv.exam_date, e.exam_date), iv.invigilation_id
